title: IRexp and IRSpectra-Bench: redistributable experimental IR band lists, a blind peak-list benchmark, and a recall-bound diagnosis of LLM elucidation — dataset, benchmark, and forward-verification code
description: Open data and code for the manuscript "IRexp and IRSpectra-Bench: redistributable experimental IR band lists, a blind peak-list benchmark, and a recall-bound diagnosis of LLM elucidation." Includes IRexp (121,233 experimental-IR records with per-record licence stamps; 43,060 structure-linked; 33,201 full IR + 1H + 13C + structure quadruples), licence-segregated pools (commercial CC-BY/CC0 primary: 87,617 records; non-commercial CC-BY-NC* held aside: 20,938; ShareAlike Chemotion+PMC: 1,897; empty/unknown excluded from commercial deposit: 10,781), the blind IRSpectra-Bench benchmark (194 compounds) and its battery-electrolyte subset, model predictions, the forward-verification and HOSE-code verifier code, and all figure/scoring/mining scripts. MULTI-LICENCE: the primary Zenodo redistributable artifact is the commercial-use pool (CC-BY / CC0 extracts from PMC OA); Chemotion/RADAR4Chem and rare PMC CC-BY-SA rows are a companion ShareAlike file (CC-BY-SA-4.0); NC* and empty/unknown rows are not part of the commercial artifact (see data/NOTICE and docs/scientific_data/LICENCE_REMEDIATION.md). Each record carries source_doi/pmcid and license/license_pool for attribution. Code is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE). NOTE: the held-out expert-audit and modality answer keys are intentionally excluded; the 152 MB nmrshiftdb2.sd snapshot and the built hose_c13.json.gz HOSE table are uploaded as separate files because they are not tracked in the GitHub repository.
